head.title: Build it, make it, break it. Get paid in $FLYAI.
head.lede: Memes, videos, bots, research and bug reports for fly.ai. Sign in with your wallet, enter or apply, and we pay the winners from the team wallet. Every payout is listed here with its transaction.

steps.contest_text: Send your work before the deadline. When it ends we pick the best entries and pay them.
steps.apply_text: Pitch your plan and show past work. We pick one builder, they hand in the final work, and we pay when it's approved.
steps.paid_text: Winners are paid in $FLYAI to the wallet they signed in with. The payment transaction is listed on the bounty.

list.none_open: No open bounties right now. Follow @flydotai for the next ones.

form.link_apply: Link to your past work (GitHub, portfolio, X)
form.note_apply: Your plan: what you'll build and by when
form.sent: Sent. You can edit it until we review it.

status.picked: Picked: hand in your final work

rules.title: Rules
rules.r1: One X account per wallet, on every bounty. You're paid to the wallet you signed in with.
rules.r2: Your own work only. No bots, no AI-written spam, no farming with many wallets. We check winners' wallets on-chain before paying, and farmers are blocked.
rules.r3: You can edit your entry until we review it. Entries stay private until they win.
rules.r4: The team picks the winners. A bounty can end with fewer winners than planned if the entries aren't good enough.
rules.r5: Found a security bug? Don't post it publicly. Send a DM to @flydotai first, then enter the security bounty with a private link.

footer.note: Bounties are a team promotion paid at the team's discretion, not a right attached to $FLYAI.
